hardened_semantics: Exact-city event evidence must bind the event itself to Cherkasy; regional Cherkasy-oblast wording is insufficient.
Regional explosion wording cannot be combined with exact-city PPO wording unless the current composition rule deterministically proves the same city event.
Publication time is not event time.
City, event, attack context and time are not borrowed across separate incidents in the same article.
Headlines are used only when the source structure deterministically ties the headline to the event-local section.
